title: Add up 1 to n
hints: Run it and compare. For 4 it gives 6, which is 1 + 2 + 3. Which number never got added?
`range(1, n)` stops before `n`. What stop number makes the last value `n` itself?
Change the loop line to `for i in range(1, n + 1):`.

answer.explain: `range(1, n)` gives 1 up to `n - 1`, so the starter leaves out `n`. The reference loops over `range(1, n + 1)`. When a loop's answer is a little off, check the first and last value it sees.
